title: SIMOTICS T-1FW3 Complete Torque Motors — Configuration Manual
locator: Section 6.2 Slot ripple and accuracy; stated motor models, SINAMICS S servo control, pulse frequency and torque-control conditions
notes: The manual reports slot-ripple/torque-accuracy data for named SIMOTICS T-1FW3 shaft-height variants under specified SINAMICS S control, construction, pulse-frequency and torque operating conditions. Its explanation lists motor slot ripple, encoder resolution and inverter voltage resolution as torque-ripple contributors. Product-family values are not universal direct-drive motor or machine-axis acceptance limits. PDF is linked only, not archived.
